summary: Three climbers — Alan Smith (42) of Glen Haven and Holmes and Austin Holmes (early 20s, not related) of Estes Park — spent an unplanned night on Kieners Route on Longs Peak; family notified rangers Oct 3 but initially declined assistance; after text contact Oct 4 showed them unprepared for the overnight, rangers launched a SAR mission, reached them at 2:50 p.m., performed technical rescues off Kieners Route and down the lower North Face to the Boulder Field, then walked them to the trailhead; all three uninjured but cold, dehydrated and tired.
location: Kieners Route / North Face, Longs Peak
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue
notes: Date = family-notification/search-initiation date Oct 3 (missing-report convention); technical rescue completed Oct 4. Parent-opened run 585.
